# The modular path — the tutorial sculpted from the class system

*Generated by `tools/modular_path.py` from `commons/modular/terms.json` (the terms), `commons/data/modular_signatures.json` (what the scanner reads each registry artifact as — a hypothesis) and `commons/data/void_spawnlists.json` (where those artifacts stand). Do not edit; edit the terms.*

Every lesson is one term, built from terms the learner has already met: the order is the derivation order of the grammar, chapter by chapter. Each term is also a registry token, `mod_<term>`, spawnable from the wrist menu and placeable in rooms.json or a map, so a lesson can be stood in before it is read.
